scope: 32 frozen accepted source districts, including accepted cross-boundary recoveries; no subsequent districts included.

activePlaces.provenance: Published place rows retain the Overture source ID, release and accepted receipt revision. Original provider-level sources records remain in the read-only Overture source archive and district receipts; they are not embedded as a sources.provenance_json field in this distribution.
activePlaces.modifications: Accepted district decisions select source places, assign writing categories and direct parent relationships, and add 1,424 project-authored structural area objects. Names and adopted position corrections follow the accepted district records. No legacy map, food or clothing place catalog is merged into the active place set.
activePlaces.contentStatus: Place bodies, summaries and built-in place text packages are empty. Pending and excluded source records are not active.
activePlaces.attribution: Overture Maps Foundation and the original providers identified in the retained Overture source records. The bundled Foursquare NOTICE and license texts are preserved.

railwayScope.description: Railway traces and line metadata are retained as geographic background. Legacy station-name catalogs, station anchors and route edges are empty. This release does not enable the separate rebuilt railway station network; Overture source places classified as stations remain ordinary Overture places.

licenses.note: Bundled license and attribution files are retained unchanged. This source inventory documents the candidate assets; it is not a new legal determination or a statement that the complete original provider provenance is bundled.
